note: The PC build has no CRC/checksum on any game file; these patches are optional conveniences. Re-signing (dmbmx save fix-crc, dmbmx integrity resign-zsd) is the preferred route.

patches.reason: memcard_LoadSave: 'jne +0x42' after 'cmp eax,0x235C' on SAVE.DAT u32 @4. NOPed, a save with any size field is copied in (the file must still be >= 0x235C bytes). The only check the game applies to SAVE.DAT; there is no CRC.

zAssertFail: return immediately instead of showing the '***ASSERT***' Yes/No/Cancel box. Same as always answering 'No' (continue). Silences e.g. 'Failed to create texture' (bad PNG CRC), 'ERROR - Size mismatch in decompressed data' (ZAL), 'Scene component file not found' (SCFI size). The failing operation still fails (missing texture, level not loaded); only the dialog goes away.
